item.title: Snapchat's new 'AI Clips' Lens format turns photos into five-second videos | TechCrunch
item.description: Snapchat says both experienced and new developers can use the new "AI Clips" Lens format to turn a single prompt into a published Lens in minutes without the need for external tools.

item.title: Spotify's new SongDNA feature maps how your favorite songs are connected | TechCrunch
item.description: The new feature lets you explore samples, covers, and more about the people behind your favorite songs, says Spotify.

item.title: Mirage raises $75M to continue building models for its AI video editing app Captions | TechCrunch
item.description: Mirage, the maker of video editing app Captions, has raised $75 million in growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund (CVF).

item.title: TikTok ads are about to get a tad more disruptive | TechCrunch
item.description: One new ad format displays another brand's logo alongside TikTok's on the launch page when users open the app.

item.title: FCC bans import of new consumer routers made overseas, citing security risks | TechCrunch
item.description: The FCC ban will affect the import of all new, foreign-made consumer routers, the agency's head Brendan Carr said.

item.title: Roku's $3 Howdy subscription service launches on Prime Video | TechCrunch
item.description: Launched in August 2025, Howdy features a library of nearly 10,000 hours of content from its partners, including Lionsgate, Sony Pictures, Disney Entertainment, Warner Bros. Discovery, and FilmRise, alongside select Roku Original titles.

item.title: Ads are coming to Apple Maps, as Apple expands its business offerings | TechCrunch
item.description: Apple Maps will launch ads this summer in the U.S. and Canada. Plus, a new suite of Apple Business offerings arrives April 14.

item.title: Flighty's new update gives you real-time alerts about airport disturbances | TechCrunch
item.description: Flighty's new feature will give users real-time updates about why operations at an airport are disrupted.

item.title: Epic Games cuts 1,000 jobs, says Fortnite engagement is down | TechCrunch
item.description: Epic Games also increased the price of V-Bucks, the Fortnite in-game currency.

item.title: Meet the former Apple designer building a new AI interface at Hark | TechCrunch
item.description: The company said it would design models, hardware, and interfaces in tandem to deliver a "seamless end-to-end personal intelligence product."
